name: development-feature-stopping-decision-v1
selection: Require every eligibility condition. Among eligible candidates within 0.002 AUC of the best, prefer the earlier simplicity order. If none qualifies, retain the existing centroid. No validation-label-derived feature fitting or new model fit occurs in this decision.
uncertainty: Seven additional predeclared candidate-versus-centroid contrasts use identical normalized-body bootstrap weights. Simultaneous intervals condition on these fixed OOF predictions and four development policies; they do not correct the complete adaptive research history or replace reserved confirmation.
closure_requires: verified expanded, retrieval, resolution and formatting studies
private formatting metrics and saved-feature/model replay
completed blinded qualitative audit with original-source alignment
documented applicable-family coverage and remaining-avenue rationale
scope: A feature research stopping decision authorizes preparation of a frozen confirmation protocol. It does not authorize final-model promotion, claim arbitrary-policy generalization, or consume reserved targets.
